newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures mixed in directionless trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures mixed in directionless trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Tuesday in directionless trade as the spot expiry gave few clues to the market, traders said.

The spot September contract expired at noon at 130.7 yen, down from 134.1 yen on Friday. Deliveries totalled 2,068 lots. Other contracts ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 0.4 firmer. Benchmark February was down 0.4 yen at 139.4 yen.
"A large number of deliveries at the expiry was largely in line with expectations," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
Prices moved within narrow ranges in the afternoon session as trade was dominated by position adjustment, traders said.
